SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q15. What is the main source of credit for the rich urban households in India?  
(A) Formal sector  
(B) Informal sector 
(C) Moneylenders  
(D) Traders

Answer / Solution:
What is the main source of credit for the rich urban households in India? 
(A) Formal sector 
Reasoning: Rich households depend on banks (formal), while poor depend 
n informal sources.
